notes:
Summary:
- Glasslight runs a 15-year video+subtitle archive (news, interviews, longform features). Primary need: high-quality enterprise search across noisy OCR/subtitle transcripts + original document attachments (PDFs, scripts).
- Interested in RAG + dense embeddings + reranker for relevance on long docs. Concerned about index size and per-query cost.

Requirements / business drivers:
- Latency target: p95 < 250ms for internal editorial search, p95 < 600ms acceptable for public facing search.
- Throughput: 200 qps burst, steady 40 qps.
- Cost sensitivity: want $/query estimates for 100k qpm baseline and plans to scale. Budget band for initial contract ~$120k-400k ARR.
- Data residency: US only for now; potential EU region later.
- Compliance: SOC2 acceptable; require audit logs and KMS integration for keys. SSO (SAML) required.

Technical notes / RAG design discussion (from SE calls):
- Document characteristics: avg raw doc 6-12k tokens; many multi-media docs with transcript + metadata.
- Preferred chunking approach: 512-token chunks with 30-50% overlap vs 1024 tokens w/ no overlap; tradeoffs discussed: recall vs embedding count.
- Index scale estimate: 1.2M source docs -> with 512/50% -> ~3.6M chunks. Expect embedding storage ~3.6M * 1536 dims -> planning for vector DB and kernel tune.
- Candidate retrieval: hybrid sparse (BM25) + dense ANN (HNSW) to keep recall high for noisy transcripts.
- Reranker: cross-encoder preferred for final top-10 to improve precision; cost/latency tradeoff requires batching and quantized cross-encoder on dedicated nodes or using Redwood's rerank fallback to cheaper bi-encoder + lightweight classifier.
- Latency experiments requested: end-to-end p95 with (a) hosted API with Redwood Optimize suggestions, (b) dedicated pool with model variants, (c) private deployment.

POC milestones / timeline:
- 2026-02-18: kickoff (fireflies ff-2026-02-18-725) - ingest pipeline spec agreed.
- 2026-02-25: sample dataset (50k docs) delivered by Glasslight.
- 2026-03-04: baseline embeddings + BM25 run (fireflies ff-2026-03-04-811).
- 2026-03-10: initial reranker tuning results: cross-encoder improves MAP by ~12% but increases per-query CPU by 3x.
- Goal: deliver 150k-chunk sample index + benchmark by 2026-03-20.

POC results so far (short):
- Using 512/50% -> index size grows ~3x vs 1024 no-overlap; retrieval recall improved ~6 points on editorial QA metrics.
- Cross-encoder (small-distil) rerank on top-10 lowers false positives but cost per query increased from ~$0.004 -> ~$0.017 (estimates vary by hosting).
- Recommendation: hybrid retrieval + small cross-encoder on Dedicated nodes with dynamic fallback to larger cross-encoder in background for re-ranking on long running jobs.

Quotes / customer voice:
- "We need search that doesn't surface transcript noise as ground truth."
- "If reranker costs double our budget, editorial adoption drops."

Open questions / blockers (notes for AE/SE):
- Confirm SAML attribute mappings and test SSO in Redwood test tenant.
- Need formal sizing for Dedicated GPUs (NVIDIA A10/A30-equivalent?) and expected qps per instance.
- Security wants a sample audit log format and KMS integration plan.

Next steps (explicit):
- AE to approve budget estimate and align on forecast 2026-04.
- SE (Carlos) will deliver a runbook and sample index (150k chunks) + automated benchmark script measuring p50/p95 latency, cost per query, and MAP by 2026-03-20.
- Provide customer with 3 cost scenarios: hosted low-latency, dedicated mid-cost, private-high compliance.
